build_biknn_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph for a batch of atomic systems using the biknn_radius_graph function
run_safe_norm: run the safe_norm function to compute the L2 norm of a tensor with epsilon protection
run_safe_normalize: run the safe_normalize function to L2 normalize a tensor with epsilon protection against division by zero
compute_soft_rank: compute soft rankings for pairwise distances using the soft_rank function with a sigmoid scale factor
compute_hard_rank: compute hard rankings for pairwise distances using the hard_rank function with exact argsort ordering
